title: Juno chat wire
description: POST /api/chat: the request body (ChatRequest) and the SSE frames the response streams (StreamEvent, one JSON object per `data:` line; GET /api/chat/stream/{generationId} replays the same frames). Generated from src/lib/chat/request.ts (chatBodySchema) and src/types/chat.ts (StreamChunk), with each field's `x-native` status from contracts/chat/juno-chat-wire-v1.status.json. Do not edit by hand; run `npm run native:wire`.

x-native-legend.native: The Swift apps send or read it today.
x-native-legend.planned: Native means to; the gap is known.
x-native-legend.web-only: Only the web sends or reads it, by decision; the note says why.
x-native-legend.unclassified: Nobody has decided yet. `npm run native:wire:check` fails.

request.clientFeatures.note: The grammar the client renders (Tool calls & research rework, SPEC §2.2; web/tools-thinking-research, not on main). Today's server strips it: chatBodySchema is not strict.

request.locale.note: The reader's BCP-47 locale (the same rework); stripped by today's server.

stream.handoff.note: Background research's hand-off frame (the rework's research_background); today's server never sends it.

stream.handoff.runId.note: The research run the turn handed off to.

stream.delta.round.note: The rework's timeline grammar: which model round a delta belongs to.

stream.delta.phase.note: The rework's timeline grammar: the phase a delta is written in.

stream.reasoning.round.note: The rework's timeline grammar, as delta.round.

stream.error.error.note: An older server's error frame carried `error` rather than `message`; the Mac still reads it as a fallback.

ClientSource.origin.note: Where a source came from (the rework's citations); read when present.

ClientActivityEvent.seq.note: The rework's typed timeline: the row's order in the run.

ClientActivityEvent.round.note: The rework's typed timeline: the model round.

ClientActivityEvent.call.note: The rework's typed timeline: one tool call's record.

ClientActivityEvent.segment.note: The rework's typed timeline: a reasoning segment's position.

ClientActivityEvent.commentary.note: The rework's typed timeline: the model's commentary between calls.

ClientActivityEvent.notice.note: The rework's typed timeline: a coded notice with parameters.

ClientActivityEvent.fact.note: The rework's typed timeline: a fact the run established.

projectId.x-native-note: The Swift apps create a conversation (with its project) through sync before the first turn; only the web's first submission creates one here.

message.x-native-note: The Swift apps append the user turn through POST /api/conversations/{id}/messages, then send `regenerate: true`, so every native turn regenerates from the stored message.

clarification.x-native-note: Answering a clarification wizard in chat. The Mac strips the wizard fence from the transcript today.

preflightClarification.x-native-note: Answers to the pre-flight questions before a turn runs; no native composer for them yet.

artifactEdit.x-native-note: Canvas Ask / Modify on a selection (the quote card), deferred from Phase 3 (brief §7.1).

attachmentIds.x-native-note: Native attachments ride the appended user turn (POST /api/conversations/{id}/messages `attachmentIds`), not this body.

voiceMode.x-native-note: The web sets it for a turn spoken in voice mode; the Mac's voice path does not send it yet.

canvasEnabled.x-native-note: Legacy and native-only by origin: only an explicit false from an older build does anything (request.ts keeps it so shipped binaries never 400).

origin.x-native-note: Durable creation metadata for a conversation created by this request. The Swift apps create conversations through sync; the Electron client (native/desktop-electron) sends main_macos here.

clientRequestId.x-native-note: The durable first-submission pair (with clientMessageId). Native turns are appended first and deduplicated by the append route's clientId.

researchEffort.x-native-note: The Mac has no research levels (Phase 2 errata, Research): the server's default effort applies.

titleSource.x-native-note: Not decoded from the frame; the stored conversation carries it.

receiptState.x-native-note: Durable first-submission receipt; native never makes a first submission on this route.

resumable.x-native-note: Not decoded: the Mac tries GET /api/chat/stream/{generationId} and treats a 404 as not resumable.

note.x-native-note: The media progress row shows the stage and percentage only.

memoryUpdated.x-native-note: The web's "Memory updated" note under a reply; the Mac learns of memory changes through sync.

quota.x-native-note: The Mac reads usage from /api/profile/usage (the account popover and the composer's quota line), not from the frame.

title.x-native-note: Titles arrive on meta and title frames and through sync.

projectId.x-native-note: A chat filed into a project by the turn; the Mac picks the move up through sync.

preservePartial.x-native-note: The Mac keeps whatever text it streamed whatever the flag says.

conversationId.x-native-note: Durable first-submission terminal metadata, as meta.receiptState.

failureCode.x-native-note: Durable first-submission failure code, as meta.receiptState.

artifactVerification.x-native-note: The artifact check's receipt (verified, repaired, refused) is not drawn on the Mac yet.

agentChange.x-native-note: Structured receipt for conversational agent configuration edits; native refreshes the agent record on turn completion.

sourceRef.x-native-note: The receipt's source link in the Activity panel.

feedback.x-native-note: A reply is unrated when it finishes; ratings travel through sync and /api/messages/{id}/feedback.

conversationId.x-native-note: The stream already belongs to one conversation.

approvals.x-native-note: The Mac holds approvals from the approval frame and /api/approvals, not from the finished message.

errorMessage.x-native-note: Failures arrive as error frames; the stored message's error line is not read from done.

progress.x-native-note: Client-transient on the web (use-chat sets it); the server never sends it.

titleSource.x-native-note: Not read yet; a task's title is shown as sent.

updatedAt.x-native-note: Not read yet; the Mac orders tasks by lastActivityAt, as the web does.
